status_provenance: D2 was motivated by inspected D1/D1b outcomes and therefore originated as posthoc_motivated. This prospective transition to proposed is based on a distinct stochastic model-mediated intervention, a fresh confirmatory cohort commitment, an outcome-preceding statistical contract, and a serial multiplicity plan; it is not a result-based promotion.
scientific_question: Can a capability developed through stochastic model-mediated local experience be reproduced in a fresh destination Field from a public Capability Artifact plus destination-local development, beyond description-only practice and without exporting source-private learned state?

proposal_transition_record.distinct_causal_intervention: Fresh stochastic model-mediated source development and public Capability Artifact reproduction in identity-disjoint destination Fields, contrasted against equal-call description-only practice and fresh no-development control.
proposal_transition_record.fresh_data_commitment: 360 attempted fresh confirmatory Field pairs from seed series 1200000 + 100*i, with no R1/R2 pair reuse; minimum analyzable N 330; no replacement or outcome-adaptive sample-size increase.
proposal_transition_record.statistical_contract: Serial P0->P1->P2 gatekeeping at one-sided alpha 0.05. P0 source-fresh and P1 reproduced-description each test mean paired effect > conventional +10pp SESOI. P2 tests mean(reproduced - 0.90*source_developed) > 0 under a conventional 90% fidelity criterion. Minimum analyzable N 330; fixed 360 attempted.
proposal_transition_record.sibling_multiplicity_plan: Fixed serial gatekeeping P0 then P1 then P2; all raw and Holm-adjusted p-values also reported diagnostically, but cannot rescue a failed gate.
proposal_transition_record.sample_size_provenance: R2 paired variances only; favorable R2 effect estimates are not planning alternatives. P2 drives N using R2 SD 0.3092419446924089, true fidelity ratio 1.0, and source accuracy 0.50 from the prospectively fixed R2 readiness floor, yielding required N 328 for 90% normal-approximation power; minimum analyzable N fixed at 330.
